newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares fall in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares fall in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares fell on Monday on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM).
A shares -- distributed to former holders of property rights in the Beirut central district SOLIDERE is rebuilding -- fell to $104.625 from $104.0 on Friday.
B shares -- issued in a $650-million subscription in January 1994 -- also fell to $106.375 from $106.5.
Turnover on BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, was 7,215 shares from Friday's 8,049 and value was $760,311 from $850,968.
There was no trade on the official Beirut Stock Exchange in any of the four listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM Stock Index which covers both markets fell 0.36 percent to 899.82 and the LISPI index fell 0.1 percent to 81.49.
